limitation: same-drive mechanistic diagnostic on one short continuous validation segment; not evidence of broad robustness or cross-drive generalization

metric_definitions.peak_error_secondary: maximum raw corrupted L_t from disturbance through recovery
metric_definitions.recovery_time: frames after recovery onset until signed excess remains within 0.100 of the peak absolute excursion from baseline for 3 consecutive frames
metric_definitions.signed_excess: delta L_t = corrupted feature MSE - paired clean feature MSE
metric_definitions.signed_excess_auec: sum signed delta L_t times fixed_dt_s
metric_definitions.state_scale: per-frame RMS(F_t) and RMS(previous completed E_t)
metric_definitions.state_utilization: P(F_t,E_t)-P(F_t,0) on the same frame and checkpoint

iid_noise.interpretation: absolute-frame deterministic i.i.d. Gaussian-noise negative control

ramp_bias.interpretation: gradual fixed RGB bias, hold, then clean recovery

step_bias.interpretation: abrupt fixed RGB bias, hold, then clean recovery

trajectory_reset_policy: reset before every clean and corrupted trajectory
